material.acceptance_criteria: A CI run edits a unit cost mid-match and checks the existing units and their positions survive the reload.
material.description: A .star edit swaps in a whole new sim, so the match restarts on the new image. Carry the live match state across the swap where the new image's layout allows, and refuse with a logged reason where it does not.
material.resolution: A data reload keeps live units: each keeps its id and position when the new map places the same player and kind there; other map-placed units are removed, so nothing is duplicated. CI shows units_before=30 units_after=30 positions_kept=30. Known gaps filed: kind matched by catalog index not name; handles are cleared on reload.
material.subject: Apply a data edit without resetting the running match
material.witness: ci-status run 38913279187 for 7cdffd30055fa5bdb3e6bdb66dd4b17142c359a9; room.rs carry_live_units; ci.yml match-carried-units
